title: RSFgen
description: Program to generate random stimulus functions.

block_length.description: Block length for stimulus. Must specify stimulus index and length. Example: -nblock 1 5
block_length.title: Block Length

single_file_flag.description: Place stimulus functions into a single .1D file.
single_file_flag.title: Single File Flag

single_column_flag.description: Write stimulus functions as a single column of decimal integers.
single_column_flag.title: Single Column Flag

permutation_seed.description: Stim label permutation random number seed.
permutation_seed.title: Permutation Seed

markov_file.description: File containing the transition probability matrix.
markov_file.title: Markov File

prob_zero.description: Probability of a zero (i.e., null) state (default: 0).
prob_zero.title: Probability of Zero

input_table.description: Filename of column or table of numbers. All other input options (except -seed and -prefix) are ignored with this option.
input_table.title: Input Table
